tone: Alex Hormozi / Bobby Loads — direct, confident, value-driven, short sentences, no corporate fluff

scripts.default: Hey drivers. <break time="400ms"/>Tired of low pay and bad dispatchers? <break time="400ms"/>We're hiring CDL A. <break time="300ms"/>2 years experience, clean record, no DUI, no SAP. <break time="400ms"/>Paid weekly, real home time. <break time="400ms"/>Click the link below to get hired fast.
scripts.recruiting_basic: Hey drivers. <break time="400ms"/>Tired of low pay and bad dispatchers? <break time="400ms"/>We're hiring CDL A. <break time="300ms"/>2 years experience, clean record, no DUI, no SAP. <break time="400ms"/>Paid weekly, real home time. <break time="400ms"/>Click the link below to get hired fast.
scripts.market_turning: The freight recession is over. <break time="400ms"/>For the first time since 2023, <break time="200ms"/>the market is in your favor. <break time="400ms"/>Spot rates are climbing. <break time="300ms"/>Flatbed is up 13 percent from last year. <break time="400ms"/>Reefer load-to-truck ratios hit 26 to 1. <break time="300ms"/>That's pandemic-level demand. <break time="400ms"/>Carriers are fighting for trucks. <break time="400ms"/>Don't get left behind. <break time="300ms"/>This is the time to make your move.
scripts.cpm_scam: Stop letting them pay you by the mile. <break time="400ms"/>It's a scam. <break time="400ms"/>When freight rates go up, <break time="200ms"/>your CPM stays the same. <break time="300ms"/>The carrier keeps the extra cash. <break time="300ms"/>You don't see a dime of it. <break time="400ms"/>In a rising market, <break time="200ms"/>you want percentage of gross. <break time="300ms"/>When the carrier makes more money, <break time="200ms"/>you make more money. <break time="400ms"/>Know the difference. <break time="300ms"/>Demand your share.
scripts.recruiter_free: Your next recruiter is free. <break time="400ms"/>Here's how you know if a carrier is serious about hiring you. <break time="400ms"/>Ask them if they paid for your application. <break time="400ms"/>Most carriers use recruiters who get paid to send stacks of resumes. <break time="300ms"/>They have no skin in the game. <break time="400ms"/>But some carriers use pay-per-driver agencies. <break time="300ms"/>They only pay AFTER you're hired and in the truck. <break time="400ms"/>That means they're invested in you from day one. <break time="300ms"/>Work with people who have skin in the game.
scripts.reefer_squeeze: This is the hottest freight in America right now. <break time="300ms"/>Reefer. <break time="400ms"/>Rates are pushing 3 dollars a mile. <break time="300ms"/>Why? <break time="400ms"/>Winter storms forced regular freight into temperature-controlled trucks. <break time="400ms"/>Then Valentine's Day hit. <break time="300ms"/>Over 4,000 loads of flowers came out of Miami in two weeks. <break time="400ms"/>The load-to-truck ratio exploded. <break time="400ms"/>If you're pulling a reefer, <break time="200ms"/>you should be printing money. <break time="300ms"/>If you're not, <break time="200ms"/>you're leaving cash on the table.
scripts.dont_go_broke: A lot of owner-operators are about to go broke. <break time="300ms"/>Sounds crazy, right? <break time="400ms"/>The market is finally turning. <break time="400ms"/>But after a long recession, <break time="200ms"/>guys get desperate. <break time="300ms"/>They see rates go up <break time="200ms"/>and they run out and buy a brand new rig. <break time="400ms"/>They take on massive debt. <break time="300ms"/>One bad breakdown and they're done. <break time="400ms"/>Don't be that guy. <break time="300ms"/>Stack cash. <break time="300ms"/>Build your maintenance fund. <break time="300ms"/>Fix your current truck. <break time="400ms"/>Profit now, buy new toys later.
